confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Canary Islands city pricing, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Cocktail and wine are weaker and were set from the local beer and restaurant price relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July demand and rates vary by season and by booking lead time. Euro-denominated prices were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, so the USD values move with the exchange rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Spanish tourist and port cities with similar pricing, such as Málaga and Alicante, adjusted for Canary Islands conditions. Canary Islands pricing for beer, coffee and set-menu meals is broadly comparable to mainland Spain, while accommodation near the beaches of Las Canteras runs somewhat higher in peak periods.
